question: Who is registered as the owner of this property?
guardrails: Address alone is not proof of ownership.
A current folio answer is date-sensitive.
A current folio does not automatically establish historical ownership.
Registered ownership does not answer planning, building-control or physical-boundary questions.
A Registry of Deeds search identifies recorded transactions/documents but the legal effect requires examination of the deeds.
The website must not claim a record was retrieved unless the actual official record has been retrieved and evidence-linked.
